in_hebrew.name: Dede
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Given by God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Dede הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Dede is of Greek origin and means 'given by God'. This name was often given to children born as a result of prayers for a child, or as a reminder of God's blessings.

in_latin.name: Dede
